levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب
الحسين بن ثوير بن أبي فاختة
الحسن بن علي بن أبي عثمان

notes: The leading 3 is the report number; the first route ends at the Imam named in the words after the chain (qalu sami'na).
The second isnad (بإسناده مثله) is its own group; its final back_reference points to the earlier chain and the Imam is not written in this group.
Four co-transmitters (كلهم) form one level before the Imam.
